verdict: The accepted version keeps all transport data and the central analysis but softens the claims: the abstract reports 'signatures' of a Bose glass and of Cooper pairs, and thickness is no longer the sole control parameter. The main additions are structural: indexed powder XRD with impurity fractions and in-plane plus out-of-plane lattice parameters of the MBE films. Text was added to justify the β-function method, to qualify the diamagnetism evidence and to reframe the 5/2 critical-resistance factor. Requests for new measurements (pairing-specific probes, flake-level structure, heating checks, fit-window robustness) appear not to have been met with data.

inferred_requests.title: Tone down the Bose-glass and Cooper-pair claims
inferred_requests.text: Referees likely judged that R(T) shape and β-function flow alone cannot establish Cooper pairs at 220 K and asked for 'consistent with' wording; the abstract, outlook and MBE text were softened accordingly.

inferred_requests.title: Justify or qualify the diamagnetism evidence
inferred_requests.text: A referee likely objected that the diamagnetism was not measured on the transport flakes and leans on a retracted result; the authors added that it came from powders, is indirect and that device-level magnetization is hard.

inferred_requests.title: Show phase purity and structure of the crystals
inferred_requests.text: A referee likely asked how Ca2RuO4 was distinguished from CaRuO3 and other phases; the authors added indexed powder XRD with impurity fractions and lattice parameters.

inferred_requests.title: Characterize the MBE films and reconcile them with the distortion argument
inferred_requests.text: A referee likely asked for in-plane lattice parameters or strain of the MBE films and why shorter-c films show Bose-glass-like transport without superconductivity; the authors added HR-XRD a, b, c and a percolation explanation.

inferred_requests.title: Thickness does not order the phases
inferred_requests.text: A referee likely noted that samples of similar thickness show different ground states; the authors retitled Fig. 1 and state that thickness alone does not govern the phase.

inferred_requests.title: Rule out disorder or secondary phases as the cause of low resistivity
inferred_requests.text: A referee likely questioned why nanofilms are 3-4 orders less resistive than bulk; the authors expanded the structural-modification argument and the disorder-versus-correlation framing.

inferred_requests.title: Justify the β-function analysis and the vertical-flow criterion
inferred_requests.text: A referee likely asked for the choice of p and whether the vertical flow is independent of the log fits; the authors justified p = 1 and argued the flow is an independent criterion.

inferred_requests.title: Clarify the critical resistances and their 5/2 factor
inferred_requests.text: A referee likely flagged the inconsistent 16.8/16.5 kΩ values, the BG-Mott versus BG-FG labeling of βc, and the 8/π and Pfaffian comparisons; the authors fixed the value and caption and reframed the enhancement.

inferred_requests.title: Support the Fermi glass-to-Mott assignment in samples 1-3
inferred_requests.text: A referee likely questioned the 220 K transition in samples 1-3; the authors showed the two fits break at matching temperatures and recast it as a crossover.

inferred_requests.title: Report how thickness was measured
inferred_requests.text: A referee may have asked about the reliability of thickness and normalization; the authors added one sentence on tilted-SEM thickness.

inferred_requests.title: Motivate why a correlated oxide matters and place it in context
inferred_requests.text: A referee likely asked what is new relative to disorder-driven Bose glasses and how it relates to cuprates and nickelates; the authors added context paragraphs and references.

inferred_requests.title: Fix copy errors
inferred_requests.text: Referees or editors likely flagged typos and the Fig. 3 caption error; most were fixed.

issue_status.reason: Claims softened to 'signatures' and diamagnetism caveated as indirect powder data, but no pairing-specific probe (MR, Nernst, flake magnetization) was added.
The sign-origin of β' is explained but no fermionic WL/EEI plus fluctuation fit, p-dependence or non-superconducting control was added.
No residuals, window-sensitivity or k_F l estimates; only a statement that the β-function is an independent criterion.
Powder XRD now indexed with ~5% CaRuO3 and ~6% S-phase impurity, but nothing on the measured flakes and the disorder assertions remain.
Only a sentence on tilted-SEM thickness; no geometry, layer count, uncertainties or reconciliation of Fig. 3a and Fig. 6b in the text.
Fig. 6a caption now ties βc to the fermion-boson change and 8/π is named, but there is no separatrix, scaling or βc-to-R conversion and QCP language stays.
Fig. 1 retitled and text says thickness alone does not set the phase, but the abstract still calls thickness an effective control parameter and sample 5 is not discussed.
No excitation currents, I-V or heating estimates added.
No R(T,B), I-V or zero-resistance data; only a caption sentence on the superconducting transition.
p = 1 is now justified and the collapse called approximate, but g is still not defined per data set and bulk 3D data stay on the 2D curve.
In-plane lattice parameters and a percolation explanation were added, but the conflict with the weak-distortion rule and the lack of MR remain.
The axis is described in the caption as the 280-120 K resistivity change, but its circularity, sign and error bars are unchanged.
The 220 K feature is now a crossover in samples 1-3, but a structural origin is not discussed.
No sample table, no data for sample 9, no count of flakes measured.
'Bose-glass-like', 'regimes' and 'crossover' now used in places, but definitions of Bose glass and Mott insulator are not stated.
Matching deviation temperatures in Fig. 2a and 2b added, but no T0, Zabrodskii analysis or alternative exponents.
The Aslamazov-Larkin reanalysis and the bulk superconductivity sentence are kept unchanged.
R^SC-BG is now 16.5 kΩ in text and caption.
Fig. 3 caption now reads ln(1/T) for sample 5.
The 67 K and 81 K onsets for samples 6 and 7 are unchanged.
'Supplementaty', 'more assertive' and 'such as copper oxides' are fixed; 'fermi glass' and 'Aslamasov' remain.

unaddressed_major.title: Vertical flow and β' sign follow from the resistance maximum
unaddressed_major.why: The added sentences on the origin of the opposite β' signs and on the β-function as a criterion 'beyond simple logarithmic fitting' read like a defence of the method rather than new analysis.

unaddressed_major.title: Temperature windows too narrow to separate ln(1/T) from ln T
unaddressed_major.why: The new claim that the β-function gives an independent criterion and the p = 1 justification look like an answer to a fit-discrimination objection, with no new fits.

unaddressed_major.title: Sheet-resistance normalization inconsistent between figures
unaddressed_major.why: The only change is a sentence asserting reliable tilted-SEM thickness, which suggests a thickness question was answered in the letter.

unaddressed_major.title: Bias-current heating and linear response
unaddressed_major.why: Nothing on currents or heating changed, and the text adds 'robust across different tuning parameters' about the bias-current data.

unaddressed_major.title: Superconductivity of samples 4 and 5 not characterized
unaddressed_major.why: No change beyond a caption sentence; the superconductivity is cited to the earlier paper throughout.

unaddressed_major.title: Sample documentation and reproducibility
unaddressed_major.why: No sample table or additional devices appear.

unaddressed_major.title: Aslamazov-Larkin reanalysis of bulk data
unaddressed_major.why: The section is kept verbatim, which is unlikely if a referee had challenged it.
